source.note: The Heroes' Serious Injuries (D66) table, verified against the actual PDF text (pages 80-81) rather than a secondary extract - see sourcePage on each entry.

injuries.name: Dead
injuries.description: The warrior is dead and his body is abandoned in the dark alleys of Mordheim, never to be found again. All his weapons and equipment are lost, and he is removed from the warband's roster.

injuries.name: Multiple Injuries
injuries.description: The warrior is not dead but has suffered a lot of wounds. Roll D6 times on this table, re-rolling any further 'Dead', 'Captured' or 'Multiple Injuries' results.

injuries.name: Leg Wound
injuries.description: The warrior's leg is broken. He suffers a -1 Movement characteristic penalty from now on.

injuries.name: Arm Wound
injuries.description: On a D6 roll of 1 the arm must be amputated and the warrior may only use a single one-handed weapon from now on. On a 2-6 it's a light wound - he simply misses the next game.

injuries.name: Madness
injuries.description: On a D6 roll of 1-3 the warrior suffers from Stupidity; on a 4-6 he suffers from Frenzy, both from now on.

injuries.name: Smashed Leg
injuries.description: On a D6 roll of 1 the warrior may never run again (though he may still charge). On a 2-6 it's a light wound - he simply misses the next game.

injuries.name: Chest Wound
injuries.description: The warrior's Toughness is permanently reduced by 1.

injuries.name: Blinded in One Eye
injuries.description: The warrior's Ballistic Skill is permanently reduced by 1. If blinded in his remaining eye by a future injury he must retire from the warband.

injuries.name: Old Battle Wound
injuries.description: At the start of each battle from now on, roll a D6 - on a 1 the old wound plays up and the warrior cannot take part in that battle.

injuries.name: Nervous Condition
injuries.description: The warrior's Initiative is permanently reduced by 1.

injuries.name: Hand Injury
injuries.description: The warrior's Weapon Skill is permanently reduced by 1.

injuries.name: Deep Wound
injuries.description: The warrior must miss the next D3 games while he recovers, and may do nothing at all in the meantime.

injuries.name: Robbed
injuries.description: The warrior manages to escape, but all his weapons, armour and equipment are lost.

injuries.name: Full Recovery
injuries.description: The warrior was knocked unconscious, or suffers only a light wound, and makes a full recovery with no lasting effect.

injuries.name: Bitter Enmity
injuries.description: The warrior makes a full physical recovery, but is psychologically scarred and now hates whoever (or whichever warband) was responsible for the injury.

injuries.name: Captured
injuries.description: The warrior is held captive by the other warband - he may be ransomed, exchanged, or sold to slavers for D6x5 gc. Captives who are exchanged or ransomed keep their gear; if sold, killed, or turned into a Zombie, their captors keep it instead.

injuries.name: Hardened
injuries.description: The warrior survives and becomes inured to the horrors of Mordheim - he is now immune to fear.

injuries.name: Horrible Scars
injuries.description: The warrior causes fear from now on.

injuries.name: Sold to the Pits
injuries.description: The warrior wakes up in the fighting pits of Cutthroat's Haven and must fight a Pit Fighter. If he wins, he gains 50gc and +2 Experience and rejoins the warband with all his gear. If he loses, roll on this table again (an 11-35 result means he's dead or injured); if he survives, he rejoins the warband but without his weapons or armour.

injuries.name: Survives Against The Odds
injuries.description: The warrior survives against all odds and rejoins the warband, gaining +1 Experience.
